excerpt:
This piece overviews how black-box distillation works in practice to inform proposed legislation and ongoing policy debates around adversarial distillation. We consider how adversarial distillation from proprietary U.S. models may have occurred at each step of the process and highlight areas of uncertainty around the methods Chinese labs employed. We also consider the potential impact of that distillation on China’s AI development.

The post How Black-Box Distillation Works appeared first on Center for Security and Emerging Technology.
